future_clone.why: The pipeline reads records to elements (read-animations.mjs::readAnimations) and writes entrances through fill-motion.mjs::motionWrites, with the theme snapshot entrance tokens (distance 28px, duration 900ms, easing) already equal to the draft, so translate, blur, duration and stagger carry. Two things drop on the next clone: (1) the renderer removes the fade on every block of a page whose content is one top-level MAIN (class-sgs-motion-renderer.php::open_frame, the LCP rule) and the clone route builds pages that way, so every inner-page fade is lost; (2) allowLcpFade is not known to scripts/computed-route (grep finds no mention), so the hero fade is never written. Judged from code and the Indus outcome; the route was not run (fence).
